proposals.title: Independent board chairman
proposals.proponent: John Chevedden, on behalf of Kenneth Steiner
proposals.topic_summary: Requires the Chairman of the Board to be an independent director whenever possible, with discretion to phase in at the next CEO transition.
proposals.evidence: The Board of Directors recommends that shareholders vote AGAINST this proposal for the following reasons

proposals.title: Oil and gas company and project financing related to the Arctic and the Canadian oil sands
proposals.proponent: Trillium Asset Management LLC, as agent for Oneida Trust Minors
proposals.topic_summary: Requests a report describing how JPMorgan plans to respond to reputational risks and societal questions about financing Canadian oil sands and Arctic oil and gas.
proposals.evidence: The Board of Directors recommends that shareholders vote AGAINST this proposal for the following reasons

proposals.title: Climate change risk reporting
proposals.proponent: As You Sow, on behalf of Brian Patrick Kariger Revocable Trust
proposals.topic_summary: Requests a report on whether and how JPMorgan will reduce GHG emissions from its lending activities in alignment with Paris Agreement goals.
proposals.evidence: The Board of Directors recommends a vote AGAINST this proposal.

proposals.title: Amend shareholder written consent provisions
proposals.topic_summary: Amends bylaws so any single stockholder seeking written consent need only request the board fix a record date, rather than meeting the 20% ownership threshold.

proposals.title: Charitable contributions disclosure
proposals.topic_summary: Requests the Board disclose on the company website any recipient receiving $1,000 or more in direct charitable contributions, excluding employee matching gifts.
